forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Teams completed 1 visit; no zones were surveyed, and no clearances or declarations were completed. So far, 27 zones have been surveyed and 9 declared free; 29 areas have been released and 13 cleared.

The officer’s attention: 1 report was queried, with no reports held and no dossiers held. The access feed shows 9 zones closed. No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. Plan P10 remains in place; no new plan was approved.

The week 40 forecast, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a range of 12–14 mine areas cleared this season and 10–11 zones declared free this season.
